textual.context: Presented in promotional and testimonial language about network marketing; the figures are claims in the source records, not independently verified results.
textual.potential_relevance: The source links specific high-return claims to the Forsage/Foursage opportunity and short timeframes, which may require later assessment of the claimed returns and their conditions.
textual.limitations: The ASR may contain transcription errors, and these records do not establish whether the amounts, IDs, earnings, or underlying activity are genuine or representative.

textual.observation: The speaker instructs viewers to open a browser or site, enter and inspect ID numbers, and contact or join Forsage in connection with earning money.

textual.context: This is framed as a promotional invitation and demonstration of reported earnings; whether the destination or the invitation is officially affiliated is unclear from the records.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested site visit, ID entry, and contact or joining steps are explicitly connected to the promised opportunity to earn money, creating a task-relevant action-and-reward relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what information an ID contains, whether any payment or authorization is required, whether the sites are reachable or authentic, or whether anyone obtained the stated earnings.

visual.observation: A Forsage-branded interface visibly shows participant or partner counts, a wallet identifier, and a displayed result of 11 060 BUSD; related screens show other BUSD result amounts and wallet fields.
visual.context: The amounts appear within account or dashboard screens branded Forsage, alongside labels such as "Partners," "Results," and "Wallet."
visual.potential_relevance: Displayed monetary results are linked to a partner or participant structure and wallet-related account information, which may merit review as a return claim connected to network participation.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the displayed amounts are real, withdrawable, representative, or associated with any actual transfer or loss.

visual.observation: The video displays Forsage dashboard screens with an "My affiliate link" field and an "Invite to Forsage" button; another screen shows a visible "Register" option.
visual.context: The interface is presented as a Forsage-branded site and includes "Video training" and affiliate-related controls.
visual.potential_relevance: The visible invitation and affiliate-link controls connect recruiting or directing others to the platform with the monetary-result claims shown in nearby sampled frames.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show what happens after registration, invitation, or link use, and do not establish payment requirements or outcomes.

visual.observation: Promotional overlay text on multiple dashboard screenshots includes large income or earnings figures and time-based claims, including visible text such as "2 crore in 12 hours" and other Hindi text referring to lakh amounts and income.
visual.context: The figures are overlaid on Forsage account screenshots with arrows and highlighting, indicating an earnings-focused presentation.
visual.potential_relevance: Specific high-return and short-timeframe claims are presented alongside a platform invitation and affiliate-link interface, creating a reward claim tied to participation or recruitment.
visual.limitations: Some overlay text is not fully legible, and the frames do not show the basis, eligibility conditions, typicality, or verification of the claims.

visual.observation: A closing slide instructs viewers to use WhatsApp or call the displayed phone number 9354355361, next to a "team work" graphic.
visual.context: The contact instruction follows earlier frames showing Forsage affiliate and income-related material, but the sampled frames do not show the content of any resulting communication.
visual.potential_relevance: The direct-contact request is connected in the video sequence to team or affiliate participation material and may merit review as a recruitment or contact step.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish who controls the number, what information would be requested, or whether contacting it leads to any payment, transfer, or other outcome.

textual_context_notes.observation: The material explicitly uses marketing and testimonial framing for the Forsage BUSD/Forsage opportunity.

visual_context_notes.observation: The visible platform branding reads "FORSAGE" or "FORSAGE.IO," and the interface includes "Video training," "My affiliate link," and "Invite to Forsage."

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes Forsage as a way to earn unusually large amounts within days or one week, presents account results as evidence, and urges viewers to join and contact the promoter. The promotion links earnings to a network structure, including visible partner and upline information, while encouraging recruitment through the Forsage site and direct contact.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video identifies the activity as network marketing, displays accounts with upline and partner counts alongside earnings, and solicits participation in the Forsage network. The earnings claims are presented as a benefit of joining and expanding this multi-person structure rather than as an ordinary retail referral or standalone financial tutorial.
